どんな街でも、出航前に
交易所・酒場・広場ぐらいは
まわった方がよいぞ

records.english: Before you leave any town, you should at least visit the Market, Tavern, and Square.
records.localization_note: Keep the exact three location labels and the before-departure instruction.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.context: Claudio and Janus surprise Rafael with the restored Carteira. In front of Julio, Claudio's impatience collides with his own reputation. Rafael insists on standing on his own and Julio changes his mind, lends the money at interest, and makes Rafael accountable for it. The argument after the loan lets Rafael act as captain for the first time. The closing choice gives the player the option to learn the preparations from Julio or prepare independently.
records.source_meaning: In the other branch Julio says Rafael's independence is reassuring and wishes him well.
records.Japanese:
おお！　これは頼もしい
さあ、頑張っておくれよ
records.previous_English: Oh! That's reassuring. Well, give it your best!
records.english: Oh! That's reassuring. Well, give it your best!
records.localization_note: The reply stays on the independent branch and encourages Rafael without starting the lesson.
